I answered Pree in a thread in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted it in that channel on Oct 13 at 09:27. He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. Pree is in #central-random, so she could already see that message.

One gap: Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I linked it to Marrow Fieldworks through a Jan 2 digest, which says that account was Pree's dealer account and changed hands on Jan 5, 2026. The digest doesn't say who took it over. My reply to Pree went a bit too far and said the account "moved from you to him." I did tell her to check with Tobias before the call, so the ticket number should still be confirmed with him.
